entries.developer_comments:
~ NPC dialogue line
~ Aye, so this one's a lot like mine.  Real popular among this Exodii node.
It's heavy duty, but as you can see, it's a little less human-like than
maybe you're comfortable with.  It's a good, sturdy design, that will keep
you safe.  But you'll have to get used to going without most clothing and
armor.  The body just isn't made for them.  This is my suggestion.
identity: &Rubik flicks a heavy plastic switch and the terminal whirs.  The image changes to a more detailed blueprint of the bulky, humanoid frame.  "Aye, so this'n like thisn's, ol' Rubik's I mean.  Popular with us'n.  It's heavy n' tough.  Keep yer mince meat safe.  But if ye' wanna be real human, yer out of luck, as ye'll have to get used to goin' without cloth n' steel gear.  The frame just isn't made for them.  Won't fit.  But who needs'em?  Not me.  My lump'a'ice is ta' seal yourself up in this one."

identity:
After so long spent experimenting on vampire blood, I found a way to push vampirism beyond its absolute limits.
By taking vampire blood, a drop of my own blood, some blood no human nor vampire could ever want to drink and an assortment of poisons and toxins, it is possible to apply the process of an ancient poison-making method to vampire blood, forcing it to devour itself to become stronger.
When the process was over and I drank the remaining blood, I could now drink vampire blood to become more of a vampire than they are, with all the power this brings.
